program_text: program 11 CIS - Computer Sci and Info Systems Information Technology Technical Support COA_Information Technology Technical Support Go Back Print Certificate of Achievement (COA) Information Technology Technical Support New Online Option Noncredit New for Spring 2026 Program Description Pending state approval. Please check with the CTE Division Office for status. Students earning the Information Technology Technical Support Certificate are able to apply fundamental concepts of IT support including networking, operating systems, system administration, troubleshooting and customer service, IT automation, and network security. Students upon completing this program are prepared to fill entry-level positions in IT support or continue their education in the field of technology. This program also prepares the student for the CompTIA A+ exams. Students earning this certificate will also earn Google IT Support Professional Certificate. Program Learning Outcomes Upon completion, students will be able to Perform IT support tasks including computer assembly, setting up wireless networking, installing programs Configure permissions and file systems, and provide for security on systems using Linux system, Windows system and Domain Name Systems Interact with users to diagnose and debug and where needed develop appropriate documentation to support the user De Anza College Requirements Noncredit Certificate Requirements Each course listed as a program requirement must be completed with a C grade, passing grade or satisfactory progress Each course must be completed at De Anza College Skills Certificate Requirements Skills Certificates are awarded by departments and are not notated on official college transcripts. Contact the department directly for assistance in applying for a skills certificate. Completion of all major courses with a C grade or higher Each course must be completed at De Anza College Certificate of Achievement Requirements Certificates of Achievement are awarded by the college and notated on official transcripts. Each course listed as a program requirement must be completed with a letter grade of C or higher. Pass/No Pass grades are not accepted for these courses. No more than six quarter units may be transferred from other academic institutions Certificate of Achievement-Advanced Requirements Certificates of Achievement-Advanced are awarded by the college and notated on official transcripts. Each course listed as a program requirement must be completed with a letter grade of C or higher. Pass/No Pass grades are not accepted for these courses. Students must demonstrate proficiency in English and Mathematics by qualifying for ENGL C1000, ENGL C1000H or ESL 5, and by qualifying for MATH 114 or a transfer-level Math course No more than 18 quarter units may be transferred from other academic institutions Cal-GETC Certificate of Achievement-Advanced Requirements See Cal-GETC pattern found at deanza.edu/articulation/ge-requirements . Note: This is an exception to the Certificate of Achievement-Advanced Requirements. The requirements are stated within the description. Associate Degrees (A.A. or A.S.) Requirements Proficiencies Students must demonstrate proficiency in reading, written expression and mathematics.
